protocol.trained: ONLY the rank-64 projection; model frozen; trainable set asserted
protocol.identity: up=0 at init -> bit-identical to the teacher; asserted on val ppl and on max abs logit diff
protocol.matching: trainable params matched exactly (2*rank*d); branch input rms matched to attention output rms
protocol.total_params: T/R carry a frozen ~12.6M-param carrier; L1/L2 do not -- trainable capacity is matched, total is not; stated in docs/LORA_CONTROL.md

runs.description: rank-64 zero-init projection on the gated-memory branch, W_v/W_o transplanted from this layer's attention (repro of the headline)
identical module, W_v/W_o random at the same per-matrix weight scale
runs.control: random W_v/W_o, each drawn at its own transplanted counterpart's std
runs.note_previous_impl: hybrid_inject.py drew BOTH matrices at std(W_v); the two stds differ by design here and per-matrix matching is the tighter control on weight scale
